highlights: Wide Mermaid diagrams fit the Markdown reading width by default. Use Fit horizontally beside any diagram to show its full width again.
Scroll an enlarged diagram horizontally with a control that stays within reach while you read tall diagrams.
See the active file path beside the Viewer or Editor menu and copy the full path with one button.
Open a movable window with bookmarks grouped by file and jump between bookmarked passages while keeping it open.
Space Analyzer and the file panes show the full breadcrumb path when it fits and put hidden folders in a menu when space is limited.
